Favorites scan: clear keyed once node data is stale

A node that stopped reporting mid-transmission stayed red forever: the
same-report early return repeated the stored keyed state even when the
report was older than liveWindow. Keyed is now false whenever the data
is stale, on every path. Existing keyed tests use fresh DataTime values
relative to the test clock.
